_comment: Couples & Engagement page FAQ. The wedding answer must remain first and must remain unmistakable — Requirements §13.
title: Questions about couples sessions

questions.a: No. I don't offer wedding photography, and I'd rather say so plainly than have you find out later. Engagements, proposals, engagement and elopement announcements, anniversaries and just-because portraits are all welcome.

questions.q: What counts as a couples session?
questions.a: Engagements, surprise proposals, announcement photographs, elopement and anniversary sessions, seasonal portraits, or two people who simply want good photographs of themselves together and never got around to it.

questions.q: We're awkward, and we're not big on public affection.
questions.a: Then we won't force it. I usually start with movement and easy interaction — walking, talking, laughing at each other — before anything more intentional. Couples vary enormously in how they are together, and the goal is to photograph how you actually are, not a stock version of romance.

questions.q: Can you help with a surprise proposal?
questions.a: Yes, though it takes extra planning and a conversation well before the day. Message me early so we can work out timing, positioning and how to keep it a surprise.
Yes. Leashed, with waste bags and treats, and bring someone who can hold them if you want photographs without.

questions.q: Can we do ring and detail shots?
questions.a: Of course. Rings, hands, whatever detail matters to you. If there's an object with a story behind it, bring it.
Coordinate rather than match, and avoid two competing patterns. Start with pieces you already own and feel good in — you'll look more like yourselves and less like you're in costume.
